visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man with black hair wearing a brown jacket over a blue patterned shirt and black trousers stands on a city sidewalk. Behind him is a historic street with stone-facade buildings and a yellow taxi parked at the curb. He gestures energetically with his hands toward the camera. (2) The scene shifts to the man standing in front of a large building completely covered in blue construction netting and white perimeter fencing. He points behind him repeatedly. Intercut shots show an aerial view of a lush green tea plantation on a hillside, a historic three-story Western-style mansion with ornate columns, and vintage black-and-white photos of a busy street with old carriages. A close-up shows hands rapidly counting a stack of US hundred-dollar bills. (3) The man stands in front of a three-story beige brick building with arched windows and a sign. A large white truck passes by in the foreground. He walks toward a large wooden door, peeks inside, and then turns back to the camera with a waving gesture. (4) The scene changes to a red brick building with the words 'Yao Ji' on the facade. The man gestures toward the building while standing next to a white delivery truck. A digital map overlay with a yellow pin appears on the screen. (5) A fast-paced montage begins: a red-walled temple with intricate carvings, two people in tactical military gear holding rifles in a smoky alleyway, a wide shot of a boat on a calm lake under a blue sky, and finally the man standing in front of the red temple gates.
